name: 08009 · Berlin, NJ
findings: ZIP 08009 (Berlin) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08009 (Berlin) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
